interpretation_notes: The source cites several traditional authorities for southern bedroom placement and later describes South/Southwest as the preferred practical range. The rule applies only to RoomType.master_bedroom; guest, children, parents and generic bedroom rules are deliberately deferred rather than inferred.
normalized_statement: Prefer the master bedroom in the south or southwest zone of the dwelling.

resolved_sources.author_or_institution: Akhand Jyoti / All World Gayatri Pariwar
resolved_sources.notes: Secondary interpretive source that explicitly cites Vastu Ratnawali, Maharshi Kashyap, Muhurtamartand, Muhurta Chintamani and Vrahadvastumala for bedroom and kitchen placement. Used only for source-backed candidate rules pending independent domain review.
resolved_sources.title: Vastu Shastra: An established science - VI: Vastu guidelines on bedrooms

attestations.note: I reviewed the Phase 20A Vastu v1.0 review summary and approve all four normalized source-backed statements for the MVP; the current eight-sector direction model and CENTROID_IN_ZONE geometry semantics; SE-only primary kitchen placement without an inferred NW fallback; the master_bedroom-only S/SW predicate; separate bath and toilet treatment; and the current SOFT weights/severities.

source_references.interpretation_note: Candidate rule narrows the encoded primary master-bedroom set to S and SW, matching the practical summary in the same source. Other bedroom occupant-specific guidance is deferred.
source_references.locator: Bedroom-direction discussion: South and West are described as suitable, South as best; later practical guidance gives South and Southwest in order of suitability and discusses master-bedroom placement in South/Southwest.
